messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
What MTTFd value (mean time to dangerous failure, ISO 13849) does the manufacturer declare for the nanoScan3 safety laser scanner?

response.text: Quale valore di MTTFd (tempo medio al guasto pericoloso, ISO 13849) dichiara il produttore per lo scanner laser di sicurezza nanoScan3?
